title: The 5 Heaviest Organs in Your Body, Ranked (#1 Is on the Outside)

scenes.text: Your five heaviest organs, ranked. Number one isn't hidden inside you. You're wearing it.

scenes.label: Heart · about 300 g
scenes.text: Number five: the heart. Only about three hundred grams, around ten ounces, and it never stops.

scenes.label: Lungs · about 1.3 kg
scenes.text: Number four: the lungs. About thirteen hundred grams together, and they are mostly air.

scenes.label: Brain · about 1.5 kg
scenes.text: Number three: the brain. Around one and a half kilograms, about three pounds of soft tissue.

scenes.label: Liver · about 1.6 kg
scenes.text: Number two: the liver. About one and a half kilograms, the heaviest organ inside you.

scenes.label: Skin · about 4.5 kg
scenes.text: Number one: your skin. Roughly four and a half kilograms, around ten pounds, heavier than anything inside you.

description:
Your five heaviest organs, ranked by average weight.
The heart, lungs, brain and liver all weigh less than your skin.
Which organ would you have guessed was number one?
first_comment: Did you guess skin? Which body part should we rank next?
